findings.finding: At320px, refresh buttons extend outside their nested cards and the two sharing action labels clip. Whole-document scrollWidth checks still pass, so they did not detect this.
findings.correction: Scope normal wrapping/max-width to WordPress admin buttons; assert actual button/form/text bounds in the existing real browser captures.
findings.remaining: Fresh combined browser screenshots of corrected source are required.

observations: Renewal terms and consent/actions/history remain readable on desktop and mobile.
ForceSSL client observations clearly distinguish historical and latest saved flags; owner uncertain state fences resubmission and offers a separate read. Observed history does not assert causality.
WordPress client installed/false/historical states remain readable and retain the stated indication limits; admin mobile controls require the recorded correction.
scope: Original CI artifact inspection, not a live deployment. Original verifier, source, archive and failed images preserved. No claim of full acceptance or a new release.
